notes: The official /careers/ page server-renders a stale job list and then, in the rendered UI, requests the company-scoped Greenhouse board feed https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/figma/jobs?content=true. That single response returns meta.total and every posting with full HTML content; the feed accepts no keyword, department, location or pagination parameters, and the #job-openings section ships no filter controls. All filtering is therefore local.
